description: Redis config security audit — Offline security audit of a redis.conf (text= or url=, GitHub blob links work, max 1 MB): network exposure from bind (loopback / private / public / all interfaces), protected-mode, missing or weak requirepass and ACL users (nopass, weak passwords, +@all on ~*), dangerous commands still available (CONFIG, MODULE, DEBUG, FLUSHALL), enable-protected-configs / enable-debug-command / enable-module-command, dir or dbfilename pointing at .ssh, cron or web roots (classic Redis file-write exploit and compromise indicators), TLS missing or TLS 1.0/1.1 and weak ciphers, plaintext port left open, replica without masterauth, world-writable unix socket, no maxmemory, duplicate directives. Returns verdict PASS / REVIEW / FIX BEFORE DEPLOY / BLOCK, score and grade, findings with line numbers and fixes, and a hardened example. Passwords are never echoed. Example: /v1/security/redis-check?text=bind 0.0.0.0%0Aprotected-mode no Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).

text.description: bind 0.0.0.0 / protected-mode no / port 6379 (one directive per line)

name: security_redis_check
